title: Word Break

tests.label: one letter, not in the dictionary
every word is longer than s
every letter covered, but the words overlap
a word in the middle isn't enough
every split dies on the last letter

tests.argsPy:
r = rng(1391)
pool = set()
while len(pool) < 1000:
    pool.add(''.join(r.choice('abcdefgh') for _ in range(r.randint(1, 20))))
pool = sorted(pool)
r.shuffle(pool)
s = ''.join([w for w in pool if 4 <= len(w) <= 9][:6])
args = [s, pool]
tests.label: 1000-word dictionary

large: 299 a's then a b, words a..aaaaaaaaaa

tests.argsPy:
r = rng(1392)
ab = [''.join(p) for k in range(1, 9) for p in itertools.product('ab', repeat=k)]
filler = set()
while len(filler) < 1000 - len(ab):
    filler.add(''.join(r.choice('cdefghijklmnopqrstuvwx') for _ in range(r.randint(1, 20))))
words = ab + sorted(filler)
r.shuffle(words)
args = [''.join(r.choice('ab') for _ in range(299)) + 'y', words]
tests.label: large: 1000 words, every split of 299 letters dies at the end
